## Validation

## Safety checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] Public documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private paths or generated credentials are included.
- [ ] Supported-version documentation and build metadata remain aligned with 1.21.1, 26.2 and 26.3.
- [ ] Relevant release notes were updated only when player-visible behavior changed.
